scope: Post-lock quasi-static work from saved equilibria. The actuator curve uses signed X reaction and travel. Independent trapezoidal work uses every physical ENF slot, DPF translations and rotational DOFs, including both sides of each rigid-target contact. Net frictionless contact work includes numerical enforcement and finite step effects. Only PLA and the shanks are reported as recoverable elastic energy. The exterior-cell pull fixes the neighbouring cells. Subsequent stations beyond the stress or penetration screen are retained for numerical diagnosis only.
